dialogue.origin: こんばんは。お話を伺う森と申します。
dialogue.content: Good evening. My name is Mori, and I'll be your counselor.

dialogue.origin: 始めに、性別と年齢、どんなご相談の内容かをお伺い致します。
dialogue.content: To begin, may I ask your gender, age, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します。本日は、8時50分に終了予定とさせて頂きますが宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too. We are scheduled to finish at 8:50 today. Is that all right with you?

dialogue.origin: 中1、女子、友達の作り方
dialogue.content: 7th grade, female, how to make friends.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 中学一年生の女子、お友達の作り方についてのご相談ですね。
dialogue.content: Okay, so you're a 7th-grade girl, and you'd like to talk about how to make friends. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今、お話をするようなお友達は学校にいないということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does that mean you don't have any friends at school to talk to right now?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: それは寂しいし、心細いときもありますね。
dialogue.content: That must feel lonely and isolating at times.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いじめにあったりはしていませんか？
dialogue.content: You haven’t been bullied, have you?

dialogue.origin: それは無い
dialogue.content: No, nothing like that.

dialogue.origin: それは良かったです。それでは、したしくなったおともだちがいないということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That's good to hear. So, does that mean you don't have any close friends?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それでは、お友達とどんなきっかけで、どんな風に親しくなってゆくかを相談しましょう。
dialogue.content: Then let’s talk about some ways to start a friendship and how you can become closer to people.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: にゃんこさんはどんなことがお好きですか？趣味でもいいし、食べ物でも、タレントでも良いです。
dialogue.content: What kinds of things do you like, Nyanko-san? It could be a hobby, food, or a favorite celebrity.

dialogue.origin: 名前は自分から言ってないので名前無しでお願いします。
dialogue.content: I haven't given you my name, so please don't use one for me.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: 本を読むのが好き
dialogue.content: I like reading.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、わたしも大好きです。
dialogue.content: Oh, really? I love reading too.

dialogue.origin: どんな本を読みますか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of books do you read?

dialogue.origin: 大まかで大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: Just a general idea is fine.

dialogue.origin: 人に話しかけるのが苦手で。夏目漱石とか。
dialogue.content: I’m not good at talking to people. I like authors like Natsume Soseki.

dialogue.origin: 夏目漱石がお好きなのですね。学校の図書室で読んだりもしますか？
dialogue.content: So you like Natsume Soseki, I see. Do you ever read in the school library?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 話しかけるって最初はなんとなく難しいですよね。
dialogue.content: Striking up a conversation can feel a bit hard at first, can’t it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 緊張する
dialogue.content: I get nervous.

dialogue.origin: 緊張してしまうのですね。同じように読書の好きな人が図書室に来ると思うのですが、誰かに会ったりはしませんか？
dialogue.content: So you get nervous. I imagine other people who like reading also come to the library; do you ever run into anyone there?

dialogue.origin: 誰かはいるけど…。小学生の頃、話しかけたら笑って居なくなった。
dialogue.content: There are other people, but... when I was in elementary school, I tried talking to someone, and they just laughed and walked away.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、その人は何か用事があったのかな。
dialogue.content: I see. I wonder if that person had something else they needed to do.

dialogue.origin: もし、図書室で夏目漱石を読んでいる人だったら、お話しできそうですか？
dialogue.content: If you saw someone in the library reading Natsume Soseki, do you think you could talk to them?

dialogue.origin: どうかな…、クスクス笑って一緒に居た人と居なくなった
dialogue.content: I don't know... They giggled and left with the person they were with.

dialogue.origin: それはなんだかいやな感じがしてしまいますね。
dialogue.content: That must have made you feel awful.

dialogue.origin: それ以来話しかけるのが怖い。
dialogue.content: Ever since then, I've been afraid to talk to people.

dialogue.origin: それで誰かに話しかけるのがいやになってしまったと言うことですね。
dialogue.content: So that experience made you reluctant to approach people.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。辛かったですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been very painful.

dialogue.origin: はい、何だか淋しい。
dialogue.content: Yes, and I feel kind of lonely.

dialogue.origin: お友達がいたら、例えば夏目漱石の作品のはなしが出来たら嬉しいですね。
dialogue.content: It would be nice if you had a friend to talk with about Natsume Soseki's works, for example.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: まずは、クスクス笑って行ってしまうような人に出会いたいですね。
dialogue.content: First, it would be nice to meet someone who giggles and then walks away.

dialogue.origin: そうなの？
dialogue.content: Really?

dialogue.origin: 失礼しました、そういう人でない人とお話ししたいですね。
dialogue.content: My apologies, I meant you'd want to talk with someone who isn't like that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 図書館に、図書室の先生がいると思いますが、その先生に話しかけるのはどうですか？
dialogue.content: I believe there's a librarian at the school library. How about trying to talk to them?

dialogue.origin: 先生もちょっと…
dialogue.content: I’m not too comfortable with teachers either…

dialogue.origin: そうですか。では、どんな人なら話したいですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Well, what kind of person would you like to talk to?

dialogue.origin: 自分が暗いから明るい人
dialogue.content: Someone cheerful, because I'm gloomy.

dialogue.origin: ご自分を暗いとおもっておられるんですね？
dialogue.content: So you see yourself as gloomy?

dialogue.origin: はい、クラスにいるけど何だか怖い
dialogue.content: Yes, there are some in my class, but they seem kind of scary.

dialogue.origin: 明るい人がいるけど…
dialogue.content: There are cheerful people, but...

dialogue.origin: 明るくなる第一歩として、失敗してもいいから、一回だけその人におはよう、ということは出来そうですか？
dialogue.content: As a first step to opening up, do you think you could try saying "Good morning" to one of them, just once? It's okay if it doesn't go perfectly.

dialogue.origin: どうかな…
dialogue.content: I'm not sure...

dialogue.origin: 試してみませんか？おはよう～、といって一回にっこりする。
dialogue.content: Would you be willing to try? Just say "Good morning," and give a little smile.

dialogue.origin: うーん
dialogue.content: Umm...

dialogue.origin: きっと自分で暗いと思うほど相手は思っていないかもしれませんよ。
dialogue.content: You know, other people probably don't see you as being as gloomy as you see yourself.

dialogue.origin: （お時間ですので終わりにして頂いていいですよ。）
dialogue.content: (It's about time, so you can end the session.)

dialogue.origin: 考えてみて、すぐにでなくてよいので、やってみませんか？
dialogue.content: Why don't you think about it? You don't have to do it right away. Would you be willing to give it a try?

dialogue.origin: 考えてみます
dialogue.content: I'll think about it.

dialogue.origin: それでは、この続きはまたいらしたときにお話ししましょう。ごめんなさいね、時間なので終わらせて頂きます。今日はありがとう。わたしにははなせましたね！
dialogue.content: Well then, let's continue this conversation the next time you visit. I'm sorry, but our time is up for today. Thank you for sharing. You see, you were able to talk with me today!

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: それでは、また今度と言うことでお待ちしています。終わらせて頂きます。
dialogue.content: Well then, I'll look forward to seeing you again next time. We'll end our session here.

dialogue.origin: （はい、また宜しくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Yes, I look forward to our next session.)
